data.name: Ritesh Patel
data.player_statement:
A complete player, Ritesh Patel has made a big mark in cricket. With 41 turns at the crease, they've hit a top score of 60*, with an average of 23.26 and a quick strike rate of 147.20. Their knack for hitting big shots is evident with 18 sixes and 90 fours.

Equally good at bowling, they've bowled 20.0 overs, taking 5 wickets at an economy rate of 9.15. Despite a few wides, their accuracy is top-notch, making them a key player for their team.
